I placed a large online order on February 21 (this item included). That same day, I received two emails: first, an order confirmation, and second, a notice that the order was being packed and might arrive in multiple shipments. After that, I received no additional emails or delivery notifications—and no package. I thoroughly searched my property, including around bushes and entry areas, and checked with neighbors. The package was nowhere to be found. On March 2, I contacted customer service via text. I received a message stating the order "should be delivered March 2," along with a tracking link. The link showed a carrier tracking number indicating the package had actually been delivered on February 23. When I asked about the discrepancy, I was told to check my yard and neighbors. I confirmed that I had already done so and that the package was still missing. The response was that the issue would be elevated. On March 4, I followed up again via text. After having to repeat the entire situation, I was told there was nothing that could be done because both Ulta and the carrier show the package as delivered. I requested photo proof confirming delivery to the correct address and asked that the order either be resent or refunded so I could purchase the items in-store. My request for proof of delivery was ignored, and I was told Ulta could neither resend the package nor issue a refund. I then asked for the issue to be escalated to a supervisor and was connected quickly. She expresse

avis.titre: An sturdy first cleanse in a basic pump
avis.texte: Dermalogica fan here. For context, I have oily, acne-prone skin with a healthy dose of hormonal acne at the moment. This cleansing oil is a good first cleanse and there are two things that keep this from being an excellent product for me. 1) The pump just squirts a bunch of product out so one must be ready to receive it. You also can't really moderate how much oil you're pumping out. I would describe the pump as efficient but not elegant. 2) The oil isn't the best at melting the waterproof makeup. I use the loreal lash paradise (waterproof) which this oil gets mostly but not all off. I also use the eyeko beach waterproof mascara which is a VERY waterproof mascara. This oil struggles to get maybe half of that mascara off. I would buy this at a heavy sale price but since there are so many cleansing oils to compete with, I wouldn't purchase this at full price when I'll need another product to get my waterproof mascara off. It does not aggravate my skin or make me breakout. I'll still be finishing the one I purchased. I recommend this for someone who does not use waterproof mascara and does not care for an elegant pumping experience

I needed a product that would help breakdown and get rid of my sunscreen and makeup on the first try because I was having to rewash my face to actually feel clean and clear of the sunscreen and makeup from other face washes that weren't performing like the product said it would. It gets most of my tubing mascara off. I do use cere ve soap as my 2nd wash, and a also a toner, which takes the rest off. The only down is that it squirts out more than you need. I would buy again. It does not burn, nor leave a blurry film over m6 eyes, which many other brands of oils have.

It's one of my favorite products in my skincare routine. Love it and all Dermalogica products I've tried!

I was unaware of this while using the product for months and had developed REALLY bad acne. Puberty level acne. I've been in contact with Dermalogica directly informing them. One month later (after mold dicsovery) my skin has completely cleared up. I switched to Kiehls Midnight Recovery Cleansing oil and it's thriving!

It was so weird its like i would get a big ball type pimple. My mom even asked me what was going on with my skin as ive never had pimples like this before. I didnt know what causing me to breakout as i hadnt changed anything, in fact i added more skincare products. One day my husband said, what if its the new stuff u got? Im so sad because i LOVED this product.
